name: grunt
description: Grunt charts and tables for coding agents: the Grunt MCP server plus skills for charts inside PowerPoint (grunt-powerpoint), .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (grunt-pptx) and interactive HTML reports (grunt-html).

interface.shortDescription: Grunt charts in HTML reports and PowerPoint decks
interface.longDescription: Create Grunt charts and tables with the Grunt MCP server, then place them on slides inside PowerPoint (grunt-powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (grunt-pptx) or in interactive, self-contained HTML reports (grunt-html). Sign in with your own Grunt account.
defaultPrompt: Create a Grunt bar chart of quarterly revenue by region and put it on slide 2 of deck.pptx.
Build an HTML report with a Grunt line chart of monthly customers and a KPI table.
